title: Yunnan Congee Tacos
description: A unique fusion of traditional Yunnan congee with Mexican taco flavors.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin and cayenne pepper, cook for 1 minute.
Add Yunnan rice and cook for 2 minutes.
Add congee and stir to combine.
Add soya sauce and stir to combine.
Add bean sprouts and vividly colored cabbage, cook for 3 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Spoon the congee mixture onto a tortilla, top with sour cream and serve.
Garnish with additional bean sprouts and vividly colored cabbage if desired.
